rust_summary: data map types a native mod registers (`native_data_map_types`), merged from the data packs' and mods' files each time the server's tables are built, read with `native_data_map` and `native_data_map_entries` (`native_data_maps.rs`).
doc_summary: data maps (`RegisterDataMapTypesEvent`). `native_data_map_types(types)` pushes the types a mod registers: an `id` (`mod_id:name`, not in `minecraft`) for a `registry`, `minecraft:item` or `minecraft:block` so far; asked once per load of the server's data (a world's first open and every `/reload`). The values come from `data/<mod_id>/data_maps/<registry path>/<name>.json` in the world's data packs and from files a mod pushes through `native_data_pack_files` under the key `data_maps/<mod_id>:<registry path>/<name>`: `{"replace": false, "values": {"minecraft:coal": ..., "#minecraft:logs": ...}, "remove": [...]}`, an entry's value being the data itself or `{"value": ..., "replace": false}`; `replace` clears what earlier files set, a tag gives every entry in it the value, `remove` applies after the file's own values, and a newer value overrides an older one. `native_data_map(registry, type, entry)` reads an entry's value (the JSON the file held) and `native_data_map_entries(registry, type)` lists them. Server side only and not synced to clients; mergers, conditions, other registries and mod datapack registries are not here yet. Bundles need "hooks": @API:data_map_types@.
